$comment: Findings about administrator-uploaded (MANUAL) species images, recorded 2026-09-30 while crediting them. Nothing here changed an image: the owner asked that existing images be left as they are. ORIGIN_NOT_ESTABLISHED = no download record on the original file and no match among the Unsplash search results for the species' name (perceptual hash, 256-bit difference hash; best matches measured 104–134, where the same photograph measures under 45). LIKELY_WRONG_SPECIES = the photograph's own provider metadata and what it shows point to another species. A finding is evidence for the owner to act on through the admin uploader, not a correction.

originNotEstablished.evidence: All 24 originals are PNGs with no macOS download record (kMDItemWhereFroms); 22 are exactly 1536×1024, 1 is 1510×1041 and 1 is 1254×1254 — sizes typical of image-generation output rather than cameras. Each is recorded in species_media_assets as creator 'North Ground', licence 'All rights reserved', source_type 'north_ground'.

species:american-marten.evidence: Unsplash R0Sir8eFUNM is located in the Czech Republic, where the American marten does not occur; the broad cream throat bib is the Eurasian pine marten's (Martes martes).

species:cackling-goose.evidence: The photographer's own caption on Unsplash bnJQxin8R7M is "Canada Goose (Branta canadensis) on grass"; the long bill fits a Canada goose.

species:eastern-cottontail.evidence: Unsplash yCSr8PIii7o shows a long-eared, black-tipped hare; its description reads "A close-up of a jackrabbit in dry grass".

species:white-tailed-deer.evidence: Unsplash 3klDayorINw is tagged Yosemite, whose deer are mule deer; at full size the tail is black along its whole length and the antlers fork — a black-tailed (mule) deer, Odocoileus hemionus.

species:beaver.evidence: Unsplash _029vDTnjeM is located in France, outside the North American beaver's range; the white muzzle and whiskers are a nutria's (Myocastor coypus). Even a French beaver would be Castor fiber, not Castor canadensis.

species:greater-white-fronted-goose.evidence: The photographer captions Unsplash AqlRAjsbTK0 "Greater White-fronted Goose", but the bird shows no white face blaze or belly barring; that fits a juvenile, and also a greylag.

species:eastern-wolf.evidence: Unsplash mblYxasm0nk carries no location and only the tag 'wolf'; eastern wolves are rarely photographed and the animal could equally be a gray wolf or a coyote.

retiredAsWrongSpecies.$comment: Retired 2026-09-30 on the owner's instruction "replace wrong species with verified ones". The five HIGH-confidence findings were retired first; the owner then asked for the two LOW-confidence ones (greater white-fronted goose, eastern wolf) to be replaced as well. Retiring removed the species_primary_media row and set the asset's status to 'retired' — the asset row, its sanitized master and renditions are kept, so it can be restored. The species then receives a verified provider image through the ordinary pipeline, or keeps the placeholder if none qualifies.
